sam.pm: Spawning a thread to finalize the design-partner recruitment + graduation gates. Want an outreach script, a light screening flow, and unambiguous pass/fail acceptance checks. Keep things copy-paste friendly for GTM and SEs.

ilya_se: TL;DR tech asks: sandbox credential + one successful inference with trace-id, run our 600-request replay (node script), and a KV-cache exercise. If any item fails, mark for "SE assist" and capture estimated eng hours.

paula_cs: Incentives idea: 10 weeks of credits OR $7k platform credit + 12 hours of SE time scheduled. Add optional co-marketing and a quoted line for a joint case-study if they opt-in.

meera_research: Proposal for feedback cadence: wave A (3 partners) = twice-weekly 30m + shared metrics board; wave B (5 partners) = weekly 30m. Always collect a 1-min daily health check for the first 5 days post-launch.

aj_ops: Fast-path checklist for low-friction partners: 1) whitelist IPs or provide service account 2) run replay harness 3) accept telemetry sharing 4) legal sign-off on basic data handling. Fast-path -> creds in 36-48h.

sam.pm: Candidate scoring rubric we can paste into recruiter sheet: ProductFit (0-5), ExpectedVolume (0-5), ComplianceRisk (0-5 inverted), ExperimentWill (0/1 for sharing prompt sets), SalesMotion (0-1 for strategic leads). Require weighted avg >= 3.3.

paula_cs: Screening call bullets (20 min):
- What feature are you building & top success metric?
- Typical qps and burst behavior?
- p95 latency objective?
- Payload size / avg tokens?
- Compliance/regulatory constraints?
- Will you share anonymized prompts & allow short A/B tests?
- Require VPC/on-prem? yes/no

ilya_se: We'll publish a tiny harness and a README with quick troubleshooting. Example run command I plan to include:
```bash
node replay.js --host sandbox.redwood.test --cred-file ./creds.json --requests 600
```
The script will report pass/fail and dump a CSV of failed request ids for triage.

meera_research: For partner prioritization, bonus +1 if they commit to a small cohort of representative user prompts and allow periodic blinded A/B tests. That signal should be surfaced to PMs.

sam.pm: Acceptance criteria to graduate pilot -> beta:
- Sandbox replay success >= 95%
- Trace-id + KV hits observed in traces
- Partner-provided eval set ingested (min 40 prompts)
- Integration time <= 10 business days from kickoff to validated calls
- No unresolved critical security/privacy findings
- Partner agrees to automated quality monitoring for 6 weeks

paula_cs: Graduation target metrics for program health: median integration time <= 9 days, aggregate quality drift <= 5%, at least 2 partners subscribe to Dedicated within 60 days, and at least one public testimonial (opt-in).

ilya_se: Scope guard: pilots exclude model retraining / dataset ingestion unless separately contracted. We can tune runtime flags (quantization, scheduling) if partner signs off on parity tests. Any bespoke engineering work estimated > 8 hours flagged as billable.

aj_ops: Ops guardrails: enable canary for first 24h, rollback trigger if partner p95 > 1.5x baseline or error rate rises > 2%. On-call rota assigned for first 72h and 1-hour escalation SLA during ramp.

meera_research: Exit survey draft (6 Qs): NPS, top 2 blockers, perceived latency vs target, integration friction (1-5), top 3 feature asks (ranked), willingness to convert/be reference. Keep < 8 Qs.

paula_cs: Outreach A/B test idea: try two email variants this week — (A) emphasize free Dedicated credits, (B) emphasize SE support + case study. Track response rate and screening conversion. Will use quick tags in CRM.

sam.pm: Great. Who owns artifacts: Ilya -> harness + README, Paula -> recruiter script + incentives table + CRM copy, Meera -> eval plan + exit survey, Aj -> fast-path checklist + runbook snippet. I'll assemble partner packet and PM-facing scoring sheet after drafts.

ilya_se: I'll push harness to shared drive by tomorrow 11am PT.

paula_cs: I'll draft outreach variants and the one-pager by EOD.

meera_research: Eval plan + survey by Thu.

aj_ops: Runbook snippet & fast-path updates pushed today.

ci-bot: infra: dp-recruit-playbook v1.0 published to /internal/playbooks/dp-recruit (audit id: dp-ci-1122).

sam.pm: Quick follow-ups: add an "exit checklist" for SEs to mark manual issues (auth, residency, slow replay) and a short field for estimated engineering hours. We'll include that in the packet. If no objections i'll post the assembled packet in #pm-announce Friday.

paula_cs: lgtm :rocket:

ilya_se: lgtm

meera_research: lgtm

aj_ops: lgtm :thumbsup:

sam.pm: Thanks team!"
